description: The XGH02ZK Heat Gun (XGH02ZK) is a wireless solution for plumbers, electricians, glazers, auto mechanics, general contractors and anyone who needs a portable heat source. It offers over 30 minutes of continuous battery life with a 18V LXT 6.0Ah BL1860B battery (sold separately), has a maximum temperature of -1 °F and a variable airflow of 4.2 to 7.1 C.F.M. It is a cordless solution for a wide range of applications, including vehicle coatings and stains, stripping lacquer, paint and varnish, thawing frozen pipes, loosening tile and sealant, recasting adhesive, removing stickers, waxing and waxing, folding plastic pipes or sheets, and more.For better tool performance and extended battery life, Makita created Star Protection Computer Controls. Star Protection is a communication technology that allows the tool and battery equipped with Star Protection to exchange data in real time and monitor conditions during use to protect against overcharging, over-discharge and overheating.The LXT system is the world's largest compatible cordless tool system powered by 18V sliding batteries. Makita motors, battery technology and enhanced communications work together to deliver unmatched power, speed and runtime.
